theorems.name: Submission.cmc_ml_massOn_eq_of_disjoint_sub_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (K G : Set (Euclid P)), (S - T).support ⊆ K → Disjoint G K → S.massOn G = T.massOn G
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
